newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Sept base money slows to 15.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Sept base money slows to 15.5 pct.

text.p: Base money, a measure of domestic liquidity, posted a slower year-on-year growth of 15.5 percent in September from a year-high of 18.3 in June, induced by the monetary authority's active open market operations which reduced liquidity, the Central Bank said on Monday.
The September time frame referred to is the testing period covering the first five days of the month and the last five days of the previous month.
